corrections.title: Mark the BANE and SEE_BANE counters as strategic reserve
corrections.rationale: Activates the existing Round Mode strategic-reserve behaviour for both counter definitions that consume Darth Bane, so a hidden-zone Round applies the mild one-tier ranking nudge and the 'Consider holding' note to them. Owner-agreed content (Group 4C, issue #37). Data only: the allocation engine and the confirm-before-Mark-used enhancement are not part of this change. Names, required and recommended members and IDs are unchanged. No counter definition currently carries the flag.

evidence.supports: Owner-agreed C04: append strategicReserve: true to the complete BANE and SEE_BANE counter definitions, activating the existing mild Round Mode ranking and hold warning while enemy zones remain hidden, with no change to standalone Counters sort or user selection.
Exact before/after rows for BANE and SEE_BANE and the runtime acceptance criteria.

provenance.conditions: Round Mode with at least one hidden opponent zone; no effect on the Counters screen or once the whole board is revealed.
provenance.confidence: High for the data change (the property is already permitted by the source schema and read by the client); runtime behaviour is covered by the existing strategic-reserve tests.
provenance.limitations: This does not predict which hidden defence Bane should be saved for. BANE and SEE_BANE both require DARTH_BANE, so they share one unit and cannot both be used.
